thingsToDo.title: Explore Palm Springs Aerial Tramway
thingsToDo.description: The Palm Springs Aerial Tramway opened in 1963 and climbs from the Coachella Valley floor to the San Jacinto Mountains, gaining roughly 6,000 feet in elevation over a route of about 2.5 miles. It is known for large rotating tramcars that were introduced in 2000 to replace earlier cabins while retaining the same mountain corridor. The Valley Station sits near 2,600 feet, while Mountain Station is near 8,500 feet, producing a substantial temperature and ecosystem shift within a single ride. Built through complex engineering on steep terrain, the tramway became one of Palm Springs’ defining infrastructure landmarks by connecting an urban desert resort to alpine trails in Mount San Jacinto State Park.
